analyst.summary: The milestone adds matured evidence, but no forecast-skill learning claim is supported: every listed matured experiment candidate remains inconclusive with zero scientific-score-eligible outcomes. The highest-information bounded question is whether adverse excursions observed without typed warnings persist at the level of independent prospective episodes. Descriptive protection results challenge any assumption that a missing warning means little subsequent downside, but neither a missed-warning rate nor a market rule has been established. This is an evidence-milestone review, not a completed November monthly review.
